approved_scope.title: 70a: Rust conformance vectors are mandatory and self-contained: Rust verifies the TypeScript-generated conformance vectors and the shared vectors from files packaged in the crate, a missing vector or unhandled case fails, the silent sibling-directory tests are removed, and TypeScript CI runs its vector verifier
approved_scope.description: 70a: Rust conformance vectors are mandatory and self-contained: Rust verifies the TypeScript-generated conformance vectors and the shared vectors from files packaged in the crate, a missing vector or unhandled case fails, the silent sibling-directory tests are removed, and TypeScript CI runs its vector verifier
acceptance_criteria: cargo test --locked passes both in rs/ and inside the unpacked algochat .crate, where tests/conformance.rs checks every section and case of the TypeScript-generated vectors 00-06 and the shared vectors from rs/vectors/ (byte-identical copies enforced by the release check), a missing vector file, a missing section or an unrecognized case makes the test fail, no Rust test returns early on a missing fixture, the sibling-directory cross_impl tests are gone, and the TypeScript qualification lane runs bun conformance/tools/verify.mjs.

answers.constraints: CRATE-3 (a missing vector fails) and CRATE-6 (no own copy of the cryptography): vectors come from the TypeScript generator or the existing shared vectors/ files, never from the Rust code under test; synthetic public test values only. rs/src library code is not changed. The Release A package boundary (REQ-release-9) is widened only to /vectors/*.json and /tests/*.rs. Protocol, vector and release-script changes run the full qualification matrix. Deterministic vector sections are not regenerated; the TS files are copied, not rewritten.
